name: Advice and Scenarios Database (ASD)
description: ICES advice records and their catch scenario tables and notes, from the ICES Advice and Scenarios Database.

notes.observation: `createAndAdviceFromSAGRecord` and `pushCatchOptionTableToAdvice` change data but are GET operations, so they can be triggered by opening a link (or by a link checker or browser prefetch). They are not called by this check.
`upload_catch_scenario()` in icesASD posts to `https://data.ices.dk/vms/webapi/ScreenVMSFile`, the VMS screening service, not an ASD endpoint. That address no longer exists (404).
`DownloadCatchScenariosCSV` and `DownloadCatchScenariosXML` are sent as `text/plain`, not `text/csv` and `application/xml`. The XML refers to a stylesheet, `CatchOptionsTable.xsl`.
notes.affects: Clients have to know the format; icesASD does not use these endpoints.

notes.observation: An unknown advice key or stock code returns HTTP 200 with `[]`, not 404.
notes.affects: `getCatchScenariosTable()` and `getAdviceViewRecord()` return empty results rather than an error for a wrong key or stock code.

notes.observation: Field names are camelCase, some with abbreviated prefixes (`cS_Label`, `aR_ID`, `aK_ID`). Parameter names are not case sensitive: the documentation has `StockCode` and `assessmentkey`, icesASD sends `stockcode` and `assessmentKey`.
notes.affects: Code that uses field names; the change check reports any change of case.

notes.observation: `api/Download` (POST, a JSON list of advice keys) returns a zip file with names that contain the date and time, e.g. `AdviceDownload_21_10_2026_00_46.zip`, holding the catch scenarios as CSV and a disclaimer PDF.
